errors.evidence: Both pie charts contain six slices, not seven. The legend also lists only six categories.
In the 'All Changes' chart, the 'P' category (light green slice) is 50%, not 14%. 14% corresponds to the 'RW' category.
In the 'All Changes' chart, the 'RW' category (gold slice) is 14%, not 5%. 5% corresponds to the 'NW' category.
In the 'All Changes' chart, the 'NW' category (dark blue slice) is 5%, not 50%. 50% corresponds to the 'P' category.
There is no remaining unlabeled portion in the 'All Changes' chart. The six labeled slices sum to 100% (50+4+26+14+1+5=100).

The percentage labels are displayed outside of the pie slices, connected to them by lines.
